'''Saban 17 (March 4)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - The rebel armies in [[Andor]] lay siege to [[Caemlyn]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Tylin]] is found dead in her chambers, killed by the [[gholam]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Davram Bashere]]'s wife [[Deira Bashere|Deira]] is attacked after she finds a group of men searching their tent. The men are later found dead.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Arathelle Renshar|Lady Arathelle's]] forces move out of [[Murandy]] and back into [[Andor]].
